events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with multiple countries involved. This could lead to a significant increase in oil prices and market volatility. The US and its allies are taking a strong stance against Iran.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to a significant increase in oil prices, which would negatively impact the global economy. This could lead to a decrease in bond yields and an increase in gold prices. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy as it is a diversified portfolio of US stocks, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) is a good short as bond yields are likely to decrease.
